news.title: Scottie Scheffler rallies from behind to capture FedEx Cup win
news.summary: Scottie Scheffler fired a 4-under 66 to erase a three-shot deficit and win the Tour Championship on Sunday at East Lake, securing his second career FedEx Cup title.

news.title: ‘Keep your head on a swivel’: Gunfire reports rattle Beltline crowd near Ponce City Market
news.summary: People were back walking, running and biking along the Atlanta Beltline Sunday after reported gunfire sent people scrambling for safety near Ponce City Market the night before.

news.title: Mattie’s Call issued for 61-year-old man last seen in Stone Mountain
news.summary: DeKalb County Police are asking for the public’s help finding a 61-year-old man who was reported missing Sunday.

news.title: Atlanta police officers injured responding to mental health call
news.summary: Two Atlanta police officers were injured while responding to a mental health call on Forest Park Road, the agency confirmed.

news.title: Loved ones remember man killed in Atlanta Beltline stabbing
news.summary: Friends gathered at Freedom Park to celebrate the life of 29-year-old Ramon Harris after he was stabbed to death near the Atlanta Beltline.

news.title: Man holding gun found shot on Ollie Street in Atlanta
news.summary: A 33-year-old man is recovering in the hospital after being shot during a Saturday morning dispute on Ollie Street NW.

news.title: Man found dead near Greyhound bus station in southwest Atlanta
news.summary: A 35-year-old man died Sunday morning after being shot near a Greyhound bus station in southwest Atlanta.

news.title: ‘Not so fast:’ Man accused of bringing liquor, weapons into metro Atlanta jail
news.summary: A man accused of bringing contraband to inmates has been arrested after deputies tracked him down in south Georgia.

news.title: Man dead after shooting near Greyhound Bus Station in southwest Atlanta
news.summary: A man was found dead from a gunshot wound near the Greyhound Bus Station in southwest Atlanta, with police investigating the circumstances of the shooting.

news.title: Driver seriously injured in single-vehicle crash on I-75 in Cobb County
news.summary: A driver was hospitalized with serious injuries early Saturday in a single-vehicle crash on I-75 in Cobb County, according to police.

news.title: Man wanted for armed robbery arrested after hours-long SWAT standoff
news.summary: A man wanted in connection with an armed robbery is in custody after a nearly four-hour SWAT standoff ended safely at a Stone Mountain apartment complex.

news.title: Man shot near Washington Park after argument escalated to gunfire, APD says
news.summary: The victim was initially detained, but officers later realized that he was suffering from a gunshot wound. EMS took the man to a local hospital.
